en: to be ashamed, to feel shy
to be nervous, to be moved
to grill, to roast on fire
to book, to reserve; to fix
to get off; to go down
to catch a cold; to feel cold
to make peace, to make up
to save; to keep, to observe
to be engaged in, to do
to put out, to switch off
booking a place in the queue
to cover, to shed light on
to pester (lit. "to make one's head ache")
to wash one's hands of it
to get back on one's feet
to waste time talking (lit. "to beat water")
"let me take your pain" (term of endearment)
